---
# The submission title page. It carries NO identity: authors, thanks,
# funding, correspondence, and declarations arrive from the display profile
# (_quarto-pretty.yml) at render time, so the real block lives in one place.
#
#   quarto render title-page.qmd --profile pretty --to ssus-titlepage-pdf
#
# Rendered under a blind profile it yields a guarded, authorless page —
# pointlessly, and by construction; submit.sh drives it with --profile
# pretty and its checklist treats an identity-free page as a failure.
format: ssus-titlepage-pdf
---
